title: Addressing Access Issues with Digitalisation of Lasting Power of Attorney-making Process
what_it_is: Addressing Access Issues with Digitalisation of Lasting Power of Attorney-making Process

sections.label: LPA system user support
sections.summary: The system pre-fills known fields with consent, prompts only relevant fields, explains legal terms simply, and offers videos, guides and centres for assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: If fields in the form are already known to the Government, the system will pre-fill them with the user's consent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Users will only be prompted to fill fields relevant to the scope of powers and appointment under their LPA applications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Key legal terms will be explained in simple language.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Apart from designing the system to be user friendly, we have prepared instructional videos and quick reference guides for donors, donees and certificate issuers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Members of the public may also approach Citizen Connect Centres and ServiceSG Centres located island-wide for assistance.

sections.label: Certificate issuer requirements
sections.summary: The certificate issuer must currently be a registered lawyer, accredited doctor or psychiatrist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Currently, the certificate issuer must be a registered lawyer, accredited doctor or psychiatrist.

sections.label: Total number end June 2022
sections.summary: The total number as of end June 2022 is around 152,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The total number as of end June 2022 is around 152,000.

sections.label: Signing LPA and fee waiver
sections.summary: The speaker urges signing LPAs, notes many willing certificate issuers, and mentions a waiver for Singapore Citizens up to around March 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It is important for us to help ourselves, especially, and those that we love to make sure the LPA is signed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: And we have many certificate issuers who are willing to come forward and there is already a waiver for those who are coming to get an LPA, for Singapore Citizens, up to, I think, March 2023.
